## Goal
ROADMAP: old-address and maiden-name searches. The scan adds at most one previous-address and one previous-name search per broker (`scan_exposure` docstring, `src/freemyid/engine/exposure.py:570-575`), and `old_address_url` / `previous_name_url` (520-557) always pick the same one, so a person with three old addresses or two earlier names never gets the others checked.

## Order
Start only after WO-257 is merged (both edit `exposure.py`; WO-257 itself follows WO-242).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. When there are several previous addresses (or earlier names), successive scans use a different one each time in a fixed, deterministic order (derived from stored scan history or the scan date, not randomness), still at most one extra request of each kind per broker per scan.
2. With zero or one previous address/name, behaviour is exactly as today.
3. The choice never leaks values into events or logs: the `exposure_check` event detail keeps only booleans (687-693).
4. Config flags `exposure_old_addresses` / `exposure_previous_names` still gate everything (580-583); no new config field.
5. Tests drive `scan_exposure` with fake fetchers over several simulated dates and assert which URLs were requested; existing exposure tests pass.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them.
